title: Fukakōryoku no I Love You Manga Gets Live-Action Film Next March
content: Shochiku announced on Tuesday that it is producing a live-action film of Mizuki Hoshino 's Fukakōryoku no I Love You (I Love You by Force Majeure) manga that will open in Japan on March 5, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Street Fighter (2026) is More Proof That An Anime Movie Is The Franchise’s Best Bet
content: Street Fighter (2026 ) is now out in theaters and is battling for box office glory, with an opening weekend of over $51 million worldwide, $31 million of that earned domestically.

title: TMS Entertainment to Stream Lupin III vs. Detective Conan Film, 4th Collection of Detective Conan Anime
content: TMS Entertainment announced on Monday that it will stream Lupin III vs. Detective Conan The Movie for free on YouTube for a limited time, starting on October 24. The company's YouTube channel lists that it is streaming the English-dubbed version.

title: Netflix Replaces Chief Content Officer, Lays Off About 1,000 Employees
content: Netflix 's co-founder and former chairman of the board Reed Hastings left the company in June. Hastings and Marc Randolph co-founded Netflix in 1997, and the company first offered DVD rentals via mail to customers, before transitioning to streaming.

title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds New Titles in New October 2026 Update
content: As the largest platform for anime fans across the globe, Crunchyroll ‘s services aren’t limited to streaming shows and movies. The platform offers an expansive library of anime shows and movies for fans across the world, along with merchandise and home video releases.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is the Sequel You Didn’t Know You Needed (Review)
